summary_en: 110,000 shares (1.27% of outstanding) to be acquired on Tokyo Stock Exchange at maximum ¥500M over Aug 12, 2026 to Mar 31, 2027. Purpose: capital efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns as part of capital policy focused on ROE improvement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Nippon Chemical Industrial announced on July 30, 2026 that its Board resolved to acquire treasury stock. The company will repurchase up to 110,000 ordinary shares (1.27% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange within a maximum budget of ¥500M. The acquisition window runs from August 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The buyback is being undertaken to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and support ROE improvement as part of the company's broader capital policy, which also includes reduction of strategic shareholdings. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 246,024 treasury shares, with 8,676,751 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
